name: seenalyze-studio
description: Desktop live-streaming studio with native multistreaming

scripts.check:multistream: esbuild scripts/multistream-check.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --log-level=warning --outfile=.multistream-check.cjs && electron .multistream-check.cjs; status=$?; rm -f .multistream-check.cjs; exit $status
scripts.check:responsiveness: esbuild src/main/engine/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --log-level=warning --outfile=engine-worker.js && esbuild scripts/responsiveness-check.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --log-level=warning --outfile=.responsiveness-check.cjs && electron .responsiveness-check.cjs; status=$?; rm -f engine-worker.js .responsiveness-check.cjs; exit $status
